title: Kernel-based guarantees for nonlinear parametric models in Bayesian optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.13160v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern Bayesian optimization and adaptive sampling methods increasingly rely on nonlinear parametric models, such as neural networks, yet theoretical guarantees for such models under adaptive data collection remain limited. Existing analyses largely focus on Gaussian processes, kernel machines, linear models, or linearized neural approximations, leaving a gap between theory and the nonlinear models used in practice. We develop a kernel-based framework for analyzing regularized parametric models trained on adaptively collected data. Our approach uses kernels over the parameter space to induce reproducing kernel Hilbert space structures over the corresponding model class, yielding confidence bounds for models trained with a broad class of regularized losses. translated_title: 贝叶斯优化中非线性参数模型的基于核方法的理论保证
translated_abstract: 现代贝叶斯优化和自适应采样方法越来越依赖于非线性参数模型（例如神经网络），然而此类模型在自适应数据采集下的理论保证仍然有限。现有分析主要集中于高斯过程、核机器、线性模型或线性化的神经近似，导致理论与实践所用的非线性模型之间存在差距。我们开发了一个基于核方法的框架，用于分析在自适应采集数据上训练的正则化参数模型。我们的方法利用参数空间上的核在相应模型类上诱导出再生核希尔伯特空间结构，从而为使用广泛一类正则化损失训练的模型给出置信界。我们展示了这些置信界如何为近似汤普森采样建立收敛保证，并为分析更广泛的无似然贝叶斯优化方法奠定基础。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于核方法的框架，为自适应采集数据上训练的正则化非线性参数模型建立置信界，并据此为近似汤普森采样等贝叶斯优化方法提供收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a kernel-based framework that yields confidence bounds for regularized nonlinear parametric models trained on adaptively collected data, enabling convergence guarantees for approximate Thompson sampling in Bayesian optimization.
